releaseNotes:
• Multi-Sheet Batch Publishing & Printing: Publish multiple floor plans (Ground Floor, First Floor, etc.) and architectural drawings together in one click into a unified multi-page PDF booklet, separate files, or direct hardware printer spooling
• Standards-Compliant Multi-Page PDF Engine: Pure zero-dependency PDF 1.4 multi-page generator preserving independent paper sizes (A4, A3, Arch D) and orientations across all sheets
• 1-Click Standard Drawing Set Generator: Automatically creates Wall Setting/Dimension Plan, Furniture & Fixture Plan, Flooring Finish Plan, and Electrical & Lighting Plan from your floor plan
• Architectural Technical Blueprint Default: Cleaned up presentation style palette by removing Real Estate style and making Technical Blueprint with ANSI31 diagonal hatching the primary default
• Paper Space [Batch Publish] Shortcut: Dedicated toolbar button and Ctrl+Shift+P shortcut for fast multi-sheet publishing workflows
